tvShow.name: Battle for Dream Island
tvShow.overview: Battle for Dream Island (commonly abbreviated as BFDI) is an American reality TV viewer-voting animated web series created by Michael Huang and Cary Huang, who are most known by their YouTube channel name, jacknjellify. The series is about a competition between inanimate, anthropomorphic objects. It premiered on January 1, 2010, and is currently airing its fifth season, with a revival of its third season beginning in the fall. The entire series is uploaded on YouTube, on the channel jacknjellify.

episodes.name: Take the Plunge: Part 1
episodes.overview: A mysterious speaker box offers 20 objects the chance to win an island, which is to be determined by a competition.

episodes.name: Take the Plunge: Part 2
episodes.overview: Leafy and Pin form 2 teams, the Squashy Grapes and the Squishy Cherries; the next challenge requires them to sail across a canal.

episodes.name: Barriers and Pitfalls
episodes.overview: Everyone must traverse an obstacle course. Meanwhile, the Squishy Cherries have to save Blocky to avoid elimination.

episodes.name: Are You Smarter Than a Snowball?
episodes.overview: Brains are put to the test when the objects are given a quiz to complete.

episodes.name: Sweet Tooth
episodes.overview: Each contestant must bake a cake, which will be rated by 3 judges.

episodes.name: Bridge Crossing
episodes.overview: The challenge is simply to cross a bridge, which proves to be a great struggle.

episodes.name: Power of Three
episodes.overview: The 2 teams are temporarily split into teams of 3. For the challenge, these mini teams have to traverse 3 small islands, each with it's own challenge.

episodes.name: Puzzling Mysteries
episodes.overview: Everyone is trapped in a room and to escape they need to complete their respective team puzzles.

episodes.name: Cycle Of Life
episodes.overview: The teams must race to the tree and back to win.

episodes.name: Insectophobe's Nightmare
episodes.overview: The Squashy Grapes receive a new team member. Now that the Squashy Grapes have twice as many members as the Squishy Cherries, they are split into two teams of five. All three teams then compete in a 6-legged race.

episodes.name: Crybaby!
episodes.overview: The challenge is to fill the team tanks with the most tears, but things don't go according to plan.

episodes.name: Lofty
episodes.overview: Interesting shenanigans take place when contestants try and stay afloat longer than their opposing teams.

episodes.name: A Leg Up In The Race
episodes.overview: The teams are disbanded, marking a new stage in the game

episodes.name: Don't Lose Your Marbles
episodes.overview: The contestants struggle to find red balls scattered around for points.

episodes.name: Half a Loaf Is Better Than None
episodes.overview: The eliminated contestants get another chance of rejoining the game by competing in a bread collecting challenge.

episodes.name: Vomitaco
episodes.overview: The objects are given a choice of either trying to stay in the giant barf bag the longest or making a taco for the eliminated contestants.

episodes.name: Bowling, Now with Explosions!
episodes.overview: The contestants only with arms do their best in a bowling challenge

episodes.name: The Reveal
episodes.overview: The Announcer has something big to reveal after the frisbee challenge

episodes.name: Reveal Novum
episodes.overview: A stick figure named David joins the game, and makes his mark in his first challenge.

episodes.name: Rescission
episodes.overview: The contestants have to cycle down a large hill...on unicycles.

episodes.name: Gardening Hero
episodes.overview: The contestants are sent into space, which makes the challenge space-themed.

episodes.name: The Glistening
episodes.overview: The eliminated contestant rejoining the game is revealed, and the challenge is to do the longest long-jump.

episodes.name: Don't Pierce My Flesh
episodes.overview: The game heats up when the contestants are challenged to escape a volcano.

episodes.name: Hurtful!
episodes.overview: As it's the final challenge, the challenge is to complete a mini version of every challenge throughout the season.

episodes.name: Insectophobe's Nightmare 2
episodes.overview: The last contestant will be eliminated leaving the final 3, but the Announcer will cancel BFDI if the votes are lower than last episode.

episodes.name: Return Of The Hang Glider
episodes.overview: The winner of Battle For Dream Island is finally revealed.

seasons.name: Battle for Dream Island
seasons.overview: Battle for Dream Island, abbreviated as BFDI, is the first season of the Battle for Dream Island series, first premiering on January 1, 2010 at 8:11:19 AM PST (GMT-8), on the YouTube channel jacknjellify. The show takes place in Goiky. The season has 25 episodes. The final episode, "Return of the Hang Glider", premiered on January 1, 2012 at 10:52:11 PM PST (GMT-8). A compilation of all 25 episodes was later published on July 21, 2018.

episodes.name: Yeah, Who? I Wanna Know
episodes.overview: Once the objects ensure Leafy can't return to Goiky, a new season with old and new contestants begins called 'Battle For Dream Island Again'.

episodes.name: Get Digging
episodes.overview: While the teams create yoyle-stew for the challenge, Match and Pencil invite Ruby to their alliance.

episodes.name: Insectophobe's Nightmare 3
episodes.overview: The teams try to destroy bugs in their glass boxes. Meanwhile, Ruby opens up about an issue that's been bothering her to the alliance.

episodes.name: Zeeky Boogy Doog
episodes.overview: After realizing that they don't have a prize as Leafy stole it last season, the contestants try to recreate Dream Island.

episodes.name: Get in the Van
episodes.overview: Team No Name, W.O.A.H Bunch, and the newly formed FreeSmart begin their race to the summit of Yoyle Mountain.

episodes.name: BFDIA 5b
episodes.overview: This part of the episode is a puzzle-platform game using Adobe Flash. The FreeSmart members, trapped inside Evil Leafy after the events of BFDIA 5a, traverse through and escape her body using different abilities.

episodes.name: No More Snow!
episodes.overview: FreeSmart escapes Evil Leafy after being trapped inside her. Meanwhile, Fries and Puffball look for the rest of their team while the W.O.A.H Bunch members make more "progress"...

episodes.name: It's a Monster
episodes.overview: A new recovery center is delivered to the remaining contestants by the Firey Speaker Box. After months of cranking, the dead members in FreeSmart and W.O.A.H. Bunch are recovered, and the teams continue to travel to Yoyle City.

episodes.name: The Long-lost Yoyle City
episodes.overview: Team No Name takes a shortcut through the infamous David Land and W.O.A.H bunch try to catch up to the others. Freesmart makes it to Yoyleland but problems arise before they can get to the summit.

episodes.name: Well Rested
episodes.overview: After the events of the last challenge, the only recovery center left is glued to the ground, forcing the contestants to live in Yoyle City. The next challenge is to find a place to sleep overnight.

episodes.name: Intruder Alert
episodes.overview: Due to TV stealing the key to open the Locker of Losers, the remaining contestants have to make the deadliest chamber they can. Meanwhile, Freesmart has trouble figuring out what to do.

episodes.name: Meaty
episodes.overview: The contestants travel back to the plains for the next elimination. With Firey Speaker Box unable to host, Puffball Speaker Box is chosen to replace him and challenges the contestants to paint the Eiffel Tower.

episodes.name: Catch These Hands
episodes.overview: Puffball Speaker Box decides to make everyone play a deadly game of charades.

episodes.name: Taste the Sweetness
episodes.overview: Thanks to Ice Cube showing off her "beautiful face", there are now only 2 teams: the "Beautiful Face Devotion Institute" and "Fries". The challenge is to make ice cream, with the team who made the least amount of sales losing.

episodes.name: Lots of Mud
episodes.overview: Following the destruction of Puffball Speaker Box and the subsequent team reforms, Flower takes over as host and the challenge becomes tearing off her petals.

episodes.name: Insectophobe's Nightmare 4
episodes.overview: A bug problem at Flower's fashion store inadvertently leads to her death and said bugs taking over as hosts, with the teams put through a last man standing contest to see who can outwit each other by using bugs as ammunition.

episodes.name: Well, Look Who It Is!
episodes.overview: The WTF contestants escape, and decide to explore Yoyle City. Meanwhile, Coiny tries to return Pin back to normal.

episodes.name: PointyPointyPointy ♫
episodes.overview: The previously eliminated contestants take over as hosts, and the remaining players are tasked with reaching the top of a spire surrounded by five islands. However, tensions are high as Pin and Coiny seek revenge against FreeSmart.

episodes.name: Spore Day
episodes.overview: As 3 teams of 3, the contestants are faced with getting all their members inside the birdhouse of greater Goiky - the epitome of interior design.

episodes.name: Respect to the Wicked
episodes.overview: The remaining teams face their next challenge: a game of "Scavenger Tag". Each team must hide their most valued trinkets and tag the other teams trinkets.

episodes.name: Start the Shift
episodes.overview: The eliminated contestants now host the show. Their challenge requires the contestants to return to their original form. Meanwhile, Tennis Ball and Nickel get stuck travelling through time.

episodes.name: Airplanes in the Night Sky
episodes.overview: The teams are dissolved and the featured challenge is for each contestant to turn on all three of their designated beacons.
A fish monster becomes the host and the challenge is for each contestant to collect and distribute 10 items each in their baskets.

episodes.name: Launch Party
episodes.overview: The challenge continues off from the last episode. Book and Pin form an alliance which disbands later on. Pin and Coiny are then up for elimination after the latter does an unthinkable move.

episodes.name: We're Not Friends
episodes.overview: The TLC begins the lengthy count for who will be the next host. In the meantime, Pin helps Leafy find a yellow tomato to change her back to normal.

episodes.name: I'm the Main Character
episodes.overview: As the new host of BFDIA, Leafy takes the final four on a round-the-world expedition for the next contest.

episodes.name: Shattered!
episodes.overview: The final 3 contestants of BFDIA compete in their final contest: a culmination of every previous challenge.

episodes.name: Say Hijack
episodes.overview: The last eliminated contestant will be revealed - but nobody wants to host. so the final 3 challenge themselves to a series of steps to go on with the elimination, however - things don't go so easy for everyone.

episodes.name: She Deserves This
episodes.overview: The Final 2 of BFDIA go on a journey to the final Cake at Stake, collecting friends and memories along the way.

seasons.name: Battle for Dream Island Again
seasons.overview: Battle for Dream Island Again (also called BFDIA in short) is the second season of the Battle for Dream Island series. It premiered on June 29, 2012 with the release of "Yeah, Who? I Wanna Know", and concluded on May 18, 2026 with the release of "She Deserves This".

episodes.name: Welcome Back
episodes.overview: Set sometime after the conclusion of BFDIA, the contestants have mostly settled into Yoyle City and have various misadventures.

episodes.name: IDFB 2
episodes.overview: This episode hasn't been released yet.

seasons.name: dnalsI maerD rof elttaB
seasons.overview: dnalsI maerD roF elttaB (abbreviated as IDFB, also known as Island Dream for Battle or jokingly as It's Deep Fried Breaths, or shown in the intro as dnalsI maerD roF elttaB) is the third season of the Battle for Dream Island series. It premiered on September 1, 2016 at 8:00:20 AM PDT (UTC-7) with the release of "Welcome Back", taking place in Yoyleland, as of In-universe order from the October 2, 2016 137 Days after the events of "She Deserves This".

episodes.name: Getting Teardrop to Talk
episodes.overview: Set sometime after IDFB, everyone is freed from the TLC and all the objects are back in the land of Goiky. Life is calm until 2 mysterious creatures offer a life-changing opportunity that they will have to battle for.

episodes.name: Lick Your Way to Freedom
episodes.overview: To save their friends and win the challenge, the contestants must free them from giant jawbreakers.

episodes.name: Why Would You Do This on a Swingset
episodes.overview: Each team has to spin on a swing set fifty times. Meanwhile, Taco is still trapped in a jawbreaker.

episodes.name: Today's Very Special Episode
episodes.overview: As it's the 4th episode, Four makes a challenge that is all about making any kind of art of him with the worst losing.

episodes.name: Fortunate Ben
episodes.overview: Whichever team is the first to crash flying their giant paper airplane is the one up for elimination.

episodes.name: Four Goes Too Far
episodes.overview: After 'A Better Name Than That' gets rid of Four, Donut takes over as host with a very unique challenge to boot.

episodes.name: The Liar Ball You Don't Want
episodes.overview: Loser creates massive controversy when he's caught lying, causing chaos and turmoil among everyone.

episodes.name: Questions Answered
episodes.overview: Donut sets up a quiz challenge and Bubble has immense pressure put on her, mainly from Match.

episodes.name: This Episode Is About Basketball
episodes.overview: X's last minute challenge involves the objects attempting to weight the propeller baskets down with bouncy balls so it can hit their respective button.

episodes.name: Enter the Exit
episodes.overview: Four has a special surprise for the eliminated contestants in EXIT.

episodes.name: Get to the Top in 500 Steps
episodes.overview: One member from each team has to climb a giant set of stairs to press a button so their team can win.

episodes.name: What Do You Think of Roleplay?
episodes.overview: When one object from each team gets their mind switched with another object from a different team, the teams have to work out who's the fake.

episodes.name: Return of the Rocket Ship
episodes.overview: Barf Bag tries her best to comfort Spongy, who is still upset about the events of last episode, while the contestants dig underground to find X's buried emeralds. Part 1 of 2.

episodes.name: Don't Dig Straight Down
episodes.overview: As half the teams travel underground to find emeralds, chaos ensues when Team Ice Cube accidentally causes a giant lava spill underground. During this Book contemplates how she's been acting towards Taco. Part 2 of 2.

episodes.name: The Four is Lava
episodes.overview: Now that the lava is everywhere and contestants are scattered around, Four bases the challenge on getting to them without dying to the lava.

episodes.name: The Escape from Four
episodes.overview: The Exit-ers come up with a master plan to escape the EXIT. Meanwhile, a special visitor arrives and stirs up the competition.

episodes.name: X Marks the Spot
episodes.overview: Four is upset because he doesn't have X as his co-host anymore, so the contestants set out to go retrieve him from Two "host of TPOT" as the challenge.

episodes.name: Take the Tower
episodes.overview: The teams are tasked with taking down the opposing team's tower, so contestants try all sorts of wacky methods to accomplish this.

episodes.name: How Loe Can You Grow?
episodes.overview: Four sets the contestants to "improve the sun" so X's aloe vera can grow properly.

episodes.name: A Taste of Space
episodes.overview: As the Have Cots are stuck in space, Four forms a challenge to cool down X after the events of the last episode.

episodes.name: Let's Raid The Warehouse
episodes.overview: Four sends the contestants to get gifts from Yellow Face's warehouse for their teammates, and the team with the most "satisfaction points" from the teammates' reactions win.

episodes.name: Who Stole Donut's Diary?
episodes.overview: Donut's diary is stolen, so the challenge is a court case where the Have Cots must find out the true thief "one of the Have Nots members" or they'll be up for elimination.

episodes.name: Fashion For Your Face!
episodes.overview: As Four is jailed, the teams try to rescue him from his jail; the Have Cots run into trouble.

episodes.name: The Game Has Changed
episodes.overview: It's now a free-for-all as the teams are finally disbanded; today's challenge requires everyone to throw their own party for Four.

episodes.name: The Tweested Temple
episodes.overview: After a shocking elimination the remaining six contestants venture into the Archaic Temple in search for totems. The newbie alliance gain a new member and Purple Face hosts a temple tour.

episodes.name: The Hidden Contestant
episodes.overview: Four is trying to start the next challenge, but a new contestant gets in the way of it.

episodes.name: Uprooting Everything
episodes.overview: Four brings the remaining contestants to The World's Largent Oven, which they hate. Four then makes it the challenge.

episodes.name: B.F.B. = Back From Beginning
episodes.overview: An old face returns to conduct the final challenge of B.F.B.

episodes.name: SOS (Save Our Show)
episodes.overview: The Announcer Reveals what he did after BFDI; while Purple Face host a talk show with the 2 remaining contestants.

episodes.name: Chapter Complete
episodes.overview: After the winner of BFB is determined, one group decides to chase down Purple Face, who has stolen the BFDI, and the other decides to go on a quest to save Four.

seasons.name: Battle for BFDI
seasons.overview: BFB is the fourth season of the Battle for Dream Island series, following IDFB and preceding Battle for Dream Island: The Power of Two. It consists of two parts, Battle for BFDI and Battle for BFB.

episodes.name: You Know Those Buttons Don't Do Anything, Right?
episodes.overview: Several months after the events of BFB 16, Two allows a new contestant on the show. We catch up on the old contestants as they try to complete the first challenge, which is to get to the top of a building.

episodes.name: The Worst Day of Black Hole's Life
episodes.overview: Taking place as the second challenge, the teams must build a stack of block and not be the shortest one to not get their team up for elimination.

episodes.name: Getting Puffball To Think About Rollercoasters
episodes.overview: The remaining contestants visit Two's amusement park, which has been seen no visitors at all. The teams must help Two, by building attractions in order to garner the park attention. However, a new twist in the eliminations occur in the end

episodes.name: Gardening Zero
episodes.overview: Two has the teams travelling to different biomes, in order to keep their designated funny plant alive for as long as possible, as it's now on the brink of extinction

episodes.name: Fishes and Dishes
episodes.overview: When Two's favorite plates are accidentally sent tumbling straight into the Goiky Canal, they send the teams on an underwater adventure to retrieve them.

episodes.name: The Great Goikian Bake-Off
episodes.overview: Right before Cake at Stake, it is revealed Four and X have returned after BFB ended and are making food in the hotel. Two decides the teams will have to make them food for the challenge, and they will rate how much they like them.

episodes.name: The Seven Wonders of Goiky
episodes.overview: Lightning, being angry at his team, ends up destroying 7 landmarks in Goiky. Two turns this into the challenge and sends a different team out to fix each one. Meanwhile, the eliminated BFB contestants continue their journey to escape Four.

episodes.name: Balancing P.A.C.T.
episodes.overview: The challenge is to not fall off of a balance beam, the first two teams to lose all their members are up for elimination.

episodes.name: Outbreak At Stake
episodes.overview: Once Barf Bag is filled with lava-infused barf, the effects of it starts a zombie outbreak. Two makes the contest to stay alive. Four, X and Clock temporarily leave the hotel for a trip, while all of the EXITors split up to try to escape.

episodes.name: Oneirophobe's Nightmare
episodes.overview: Two sends the contestants into their teammates' subconscious to turn their nightmares into dreams. Meanwhile, Barf Bag is in hiding.

episodes.name: Out Of The Blue
episodes.overview: The exitors split up into three groups and explore the EXIT, attempting to find a way to escape.

episodes.name: What’s Up Bell’s String?
episodes.overview: A team swap is initiated, and the contestants have to fill up their team's pit as much as possible as the contest. One stops hiding in the background and gives some disabled contestants a favour.

episodes.name: Category One
episodes.overview: When One hijacks the EXITor debut and summons a storm to hit Goiky, Two tasks the teams with defending the hotel from the storm. However, the storm is plagued by some unwanted adversaries from past episodes.

episodes.name: I SAID CAREFUL!!!
episodes.overview: Two challenges the teams to get a flag from the top of the summit of one of two mountains, either a snowy mountain or a volcano. However, a monstrous plant and avalanches stand in the way.

episodes.name: Seasonal Shift
episodes.overview: The failed debuters altered the timeline using the Yoylite used by Tennis Ball ten years prior, and the teams are challenged to bring them back to the present and fix the timeline to return it back to normal.

episodes.name: The Power of Four
episodes.overview: As Two is still sad about Gaty's disappearance, Four and X fill in for them as hosts. They then challenge the teams to a hide and seek game.

episodes.name: Bottle For Dream Island
episodes.overview: Bottle takes over as host and challenges the teams to gain points from the reopened Two's amusement park attractions.

episodes.name: BFB 31
episodes.overview: Someone stole Lollipop's credit card and Four challenges the post-splitter contestants to find it.

episodes.name: Last One Standing
episodes.overview: Four and Two become aware of One's presence, but the situation becomes devastatingly unmanageable when one of the eliminated contestants announces a Battle Royale challenge.

episodes.name: Alone
episodes.overview: 16 years before the events of "Last One Standing" One finds a strange meteor at the Equation Playground.

episodes.name: Insectophobe's Nightmare 6
episodes.overview: The aftermath of One's takeover finds our contestants in another Insectophobe's Nightmare. And with two eliminations looming, tensions are running high as we enter our next challenge.

episodes.name: Suite Escape
episodes.overview: After being trapped in an upside down city, the eliminated contestants try with all their might to break the barrier.

episodes.name: Homeward Bound!
episodes.overview: Part 1 of the "Defeat One" trilogy. Current and eliminated contestants split up to find a way to defeat One - and to find each other.

episodes.name: That's What Foes Are For
episodes.overview: Part 2 of the "Defeat One" trilogy. It's time for Black Hole and One to have a chat. And is Pencil really in the past? What's she doing over there, huh?

episodes.name: All For One
episodes.overview: Part 3 of the "Defeat One" trilogy. Help me take her down once and for all. The end of the Defeat One trilogy.

episodes.name: TPOT 26
episodes.overview: This episode hasn't been released yet.

seasons.name: Battle for Dream Island: The Power of Two
seasons.overview:
Battle for Dream Island: The Power of Two (BFDI:TPOT), BFDI: The Power of Two, or simply The Power of Two (TPOT), is the fifth season of the Battle for Dream Island series and the sequel to Battle for BFDI, with its first 2 episodes directed by Satomi Hinatsu and Pokey and later episodes directed by Sam Thornbury, Cary Huang and Michael Huang.

The season is hosted by Two and was announced in "The Escape from Four". The Power of Two consists of 40 contestants from the original Battle for BFDI, plus two recommended characters (Winner and Price Tag), two EXITors (Pencil and Liy) and Teardrop. The other 14 contestants that didn't switch continued to battle in Battle for BFB. The prize is Two's power (currently in the arms of Snowball and One) and bragging rights.

episodes.name: Elsewhere On Earth
episodes.overview: The Announcer is back, and he's brought a new cast Elsewhere.

episodes.name: The Bare Minimum
episodes.overview: The next contest is to collect the most balls. The person with the least balls loses and is automatically eliminated.

episodes.name: Everyone's Enemies
episodes.overview: The Announcer first directs the contestants to retrieve a necklace at the bottom of the cliff, then he sets up a fighting contest.

episodes.name: Insectophobe's Nightmare 0
episodes.overview: The Announcer challenges the contestants to a snowball fight.

episodes.name: The Three Leg Three-Legged Race
episodes.overview: The next challenge is to make teams of two and tie legs together and have to pass through three different courses.

episodes.name: The Exploding Loser Chamber
episodes.overview: An eliminated contestant gets to rejoin the game, and all they have to do is keep hold of a chest. Easy, right?

episodes.name: One Hundred Shells, No More, No Less
episodes.overview: Now a contestant has rejoined, it's a beach challenge. Got to collect the most seashells on the sea.

episodes.name: Some Assembly Required
episodes.overview: The Announcer has eliminated the contestants's speaker boxes. What now? You have to repair your speaker boxes to be safe from elimination.

episodes.name: The Root Of All Evil
episodes.overview: It's a combination of all the previous challenges. Who do you think has what it takes to make it to the final three?

episodes.name: Escape Nightmare Island!
episodes.overview: Fern, Sidewalky and Sticker compete in their final challenge to win Nightmare Island - escaping it.

seasons.name: Battle for Dream Island Elsewhere
seasons.overview: Battle for Dream Island Elsewhere (BFDIE), stylized as "Battle for Dream Island ELSEWHERE...", is the sixth season of the Battle for Dream Island series, and a parallelquel of the first season, Battle for Dream Island. It premiered on the New Year's Day of 2026 with the release of "Elsewhere on Earth" and released episodes weekly, except for the season finale "Escape Nightmare Island!" on March 13, 2026. After the release of "BFDIE: Alternate Endings" on March 20, 2026, jacknjellify announced production of the season was wrapped. The prize of the season is Nightmare Island.
